D: Passengers fight to survive a zombie outbreak on a high-speed train from Seoul to Busan.
P: Serve the snacks as the train pulls out of Seoul station.
S: the snack you grab before the train leaves

Seaweed rolls of sesame rice packed with egg ribbon, pickled radish, carrot, spinach and bulgogi beef, sliced into rounds and brushed with sesame oil. Cook 400g short grain rice and season with 1 tbsp sesame oil and salt. Fry 200g thinly sliced beef with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tsp sugar. Cook 3 beaten eggs into a thin omelette and slice into strips. Blanch 200g spinach, squeeze and season with sesame oil. Julienne 1 carrot and quickly fry. Spread rice over 5 nori sheets, lay the fillings and strips of yellow pickled radish across, roll tightly, brush with sesame oil and slice.
for the long ride, if you're lucky
Wings coated in potato starch, fried at 160C for 8 minutes, rested, fried again at 190C, tossed in gochujang, soy, honey and garlic glaze with sesame seeds.
Cylinder rice cakes soaked 20 minutes, simmered in anchovy stock with gochujang, gochugaru, sugar and fish cake until glossy and thick, spring onion over the top.
M: Busan dwaeji gukbap pork and rice soup
dwaeji gukbap, the dish Busan is known for

Milky pork bone broth with tender sliced pork, ladled over rice with spring onion, chilli paste and garlic chives, kimchi and salted prawns on the side. Blanch 1.5kg pork bones in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and rinse. Cover with 3L fresh water, add 1 onion, 6 garlic cloves and a knob of ginger, and boil hard for 3 hours, topping up, until milky. Add 600g pork belly for the last 60 minutes, then slice. Strain the broth and season. Pour over bowls of cooked rice with the pork, spring onion and chives. Serve with kimchi and gochujang.
quick, hot and from the dining car
Cold rice fried in a smoking pan with chopped aged kimchi and its juice, bacon, gochujang and butter, pressed to crisp on the bottom, topped with a fried egg and nori.
W: Sweet yeasted dough rested an hour, filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and chopped peanuts, pressed flat in an oiled pan and fried until the sugar melts inside.
K: Ripe banana blended with cold full cream milk, a little honey and a pinch of salt, strained and served very cold.

s.note: for the long ride, if you're lucky
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings in 100g potato starch. Fry at 160C for 8 minutes, rest 5, then fry at 190C until very crisp. Simmer 2 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp soy, 3 tbsp honey and 2 crushed garlic cloves until glossy. Toss and scatter with sesame seeds.

Soak 500g rice cakes in water for 20 minutes. Simmer 500ml stock made with a few dried anchovies, then add 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp gochugaru and 1 tbsp sugar. Add the rice cakes and 150g sliced fish cake and simmer until thick and glossy. Top with spring onion.

m.note: quick, hot and from the dining car
m.how: Fry 150g chopped bacon until crisp, then add 300g chopped kimchi and a splash of its juice. Add 4 cups cold cooked rice from 300g jasmine rice, 1 tbsp gochujang and 30g butter, and press flat to crisp the bottom. Top each bowl with a fried egg and torn nori.

w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm water and rest an hour. Mix 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped peanuts. Fill 8 balls of dough with the mix, seal and press flat in an oiled pan. Fry until golden and the sugar melts inside.

d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas with 1L cold full cream milk, 1 tbsp honey and a pinch of salt until smooth. Strain through a sieve for a silky drink. Chill well and pour into four glasses.
